column7: With session_replication_role=replica (Helm postgresql.settings server default, ALTER ROLE/DATABASE ... SET, DSN options, or an operator session) the ordinary cache-epoch trigger on secret_nodes did not fire while the trigger proof (tgenabled <> D) still said present, so the read cache served the pre-change row: a suspended secret read as active. The trigger is now ENABLE ALWAYS (converged at migration), the proof requires tgenabled = A and an origin session, the server refuses to start unless session_replication_role is origin (TestCreateStorage_Postgres_RefusesNonOriginReplicationRole), and the Helm chart refuses the setting. Red on main: GetSecret returned active after a replica-role UPDATE to suspended.
